business_summary: Neuberger Berman Income Funds - Neuberger Energy Infrastructure and Income Fund Inc. is a closed ended fund of fund launched and managed by Neuberger Berman Management LLC. It is co-managed by Neuberger Berman LLC. The fund invests in the public equity markets. It primarily invests in master limited partnerships and limited liability companies. It was formerly known as Neuberger Berman MLP Income Fund Inc. Neuberger Berman Income Funds - Neuberger Energy Infrastructure and Income Fund Inc. was formed on November 16, 2012 and is domiciled in the United States.
business_summary_ko: Neuberger Berman Income Funds - Neuberger Energy Infrastructure and Income Fund Inc.는 Neuberger Berman Management LLC가 출시하고 관리하는 폐쇄형 펀드입니다. Neuberger Berman LLC가 공동 관리합니다. 이 펀드는 공개 주식 시장에 투자합니다. 주로 마스터 유한 파트너십과 유한 책임 회사에 투자합니다. 이전에는 Neuberger Berman MLP Income Fund Inc.로 알려졌습니다. Neuberger Berman Income Funds - Neuberger Energy Infrastructure and Income Fund Inc.는 2012년 11월 16일에 설립되었으며 미국에 주소를 두고 있습니다.
